rows.output: Ọgọ́rùn-ún àwọn ènìyàn ló wà fún ayẹyẹ kan ní etíkun ìlú Palu ní ọjọ́ Jimọ́ nígbà tí ìjì omi tó ga tó mítà mẹ́fà (ìwọ̀n ẹsẹ̀ méjìdínlógọ́rin) ti fọ́ sí etíkun ní ìsùúrù, tí ó sì fọ́ ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ lọ sí ikú àti ìparun ohun gbogbo tí ó wà ní ọ̀nà rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ọgọ-ọgọ́ọ̀rún eniyan niwọń tipéjọ fun àjọ̀dún kan ní etíkun ti ìlú Palu lọ́jọ́ Ẹtì nigbati àwọn ìjì òkun tóga tó ìwọ̀n mítà mẹ́fà (ẹsẹ̀ bàtà 18) fagbára wólulẹ̀ létíkun ní àásálẹ́, tí wọ́n sì gba ọ̀pọ̀ lọ sínú ikú wọn tí wọ́n sì pa ohunkóhun tówà ní ipa ọ̀nà wọn.

rows.output: Ìjì líle náà tẹ̀lé ìmìtàtà 7.5.
rows.reference: Ìkún-omi tsunami náà tẹ̀lé ilẹ̀ rírì oníwọ̀n agbara 7.5 kan.

rows.output: "Nígbà tí ìhalẹ̀ tsunami ti wáyé lánáà, àwọn ènìyàn ṣì ń ṣe àwọn ìṣe wọn ní etíkun, wọn kò sì sáré lọ lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀ kí wọn sì di àwọn olùfaragbá." Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, agbẹnusọ fún ilé-iṣẹ́ ìdènà ìṣòro ìṣòro ilẹ̀ Indonesia BNPB sọ̀rọ̀ ní ìpàdé kan ní Jakarta.
rows.reference: ''Nigbati ìdúnkoòkò tsunami náà dìde ní àná, àwọn eniyan sì ńṣe iṣẹ́ wọn létíkun tíwọn kòsì sá kuro lójú-ẹsẹ̀ tí wọ́n sì di ẹniti o farakó-áásá,'' ni Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, agbẹnusọ fún àjọ tó ńrísí díndín ewu ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ àjálù kù lorilẹ-ede Indonesia BNPB sọ nínú ìfitónilétí kan Jarkata.

rows.output: "Ìjì líle náà kò wá níkan, ó mú àwọn ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́, àwọn igi, àwọn ilé, ó sì lu ohun gbogbo lórí ilẹ̀," Nugroho sọ, ó sì fi kún un pé ìjì líle náà ti rin ìrìn àjò káàkiri òkun ṣíṣe ní iyara 800 kmph (497 mph) kí ó tó lu etíkun.
rows.reference: Ìkún-omi tsunami náà kòwá nípa ara rẹ̀, ó wọ́ àwọn ọkọ́ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́, àwọn igi, àwọn ilé, ó kọlu ohun gbogbo lórí ilẹ̀,'' ni Nugroho sọ, tí ó sì fikún un pé ìkún-omi tsunami náà ti rin ìrìn-àjò kọjá gbangba òkun ní àwọn ìwọ̀n ìṣọwọ́sáré kìlómítà ẹgbẹ̀jọ̀ ní wákàtí kan (máìlí 497 ní wákàtí kan) kí ó tó kọlu bèbè òkun.

rows.output: Àwọn ènìyàn kan gun igi láti sá lọ́wọ́ ìkún omi náà, ó sì wà láàyè.
rows.reference: Àwọn eniyan kan gun igi láti sá àsálà kuro lọ́wọ́ ìkún omi tsunami náà tí wọ́n sì yè, ni ó sọ.

rows.output: Ni ayika 16,700 eniyan ni a gbe lọ si awọn ile-iṣere 24 ni Palu.
rows.reference: Àwọn eniyan bíi ẹgbẹ̀rún mẹ́tadínlógúndín-lọ́ọ̀dún ni wọn yára gbélọ sí àwọn ibùdó ní Palu.

rows.output: Àwọn fọ́tò afẹ́fẹ́ tí ilé-iṣẹ́ ìṣípayá ti ṣe àfihàn pé ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ilé àti ilé ìtajà ti bàjẹ́, àwọn afara ti yí padà àti ti ṣubú, àti mọ́ṣáláṣí kan tí omi yí ká.
rows.reference: Àwọn fọ́tò àtòkèya tí àjọ tó ńrísí ìṣẹ̀lẹ àjálù náà gbéjáde fi ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn ilé àti àwọn sọ́ọ̀bù tí o ti bàjẹ́, àwọn afárá tí ó ti wọ́ tí ó sì wọ́ lulẹ̀ àti mọ́sálásí kan tí omi ti yípo.

rows.output: Àwọn ìkún omi ń bá ìlú etí òkun náà jẹ́ ní ọjọ́ Satide.
rows.reference: Àwọn ìmìtìtì-ilẹ̀ tẹ̀síwájú láti máa mú ìlú ẹ̀bá òkun náà rọ́kẹ̀kẹ̀ lọ́jọ́ Àbámẹ́ta.

rows.output: Àwọn ìṣòro ilẹ̀ ayé náà ni wọ́n rí ní àgbègbè tí ó ní ènìyàn 2.4 mílíọ̀nù.
rows.reference: Àwọn ilẹ̀ rírì oní-ṣiṣẹ̀-ń-tẹ̀lé náà ní wọ́n mọ̀lára ní agbègbe kan tóní mílíọ̀nù méjí àti irinwó eniyan.

rows.output: Ìjọbá Indonesia fún Àyẹ̀wò àti Ìmúlò Ìmọ̀ ẹ̀rọ (BPPT) sọ nínú ìkìlọ̀ pé agbára tí ìkún omi tó tóbi jù lọ tí ó ṣẹlẹ̀ ní ọjọ́ Jimọ́ náà jẹ́ tó 200 ìgbà agbára bọ́mù àtòmíkì tí wọ́n ju sí Hiroshima nígbá ogun àgbáyé Kejì.
rows.reference: Àjọ tó Ńse Àgbéléwọ̀n àti Ìsàmúlò Ìmọ̀-ẹ̀rọ ti ilẹ̀ Indonesia (BPPT) sọ ninu gbólóhùn wipe agbára tí ọ̀pọ̀ ilẹ̀-rírì ọjọ́ Ẹtì náà tú síta tó bíi i̇̀lopọ̀ igba ti àdó-olóró tí wọ́n jù sórí ìlú Hiroshima nigba Ogun Àgbáyé Kejì.

rows.output: Ìsọ̀rí ìlú náà, tí ó wà ní òpin ọ̀nà àfonífojì tí ó gùn jù, lè ti pọ̀ sí i ní ìwọ̀n ìkún omi, ó sọ.
rows.reference: Ìṣẹ̀dá orí-ilẹ̀ ìlú náà, eyiti ó jókòó sí òpin ilẹ̀ tówọnú òkun, gíguǹ kan, leè ti mú ìwọ̀n ìkún-omi tsunami náà gbòòrò síi, ní ó wí.

rows.output: Nugroho ṣe àpèjúwe ìbàjẹ́ náà gẹ́gẹ́ bí “ìbàjẹ́ púpọ̀” ó sì sọ pé ọ̀pọ̀lùpọ̀ ilé, ilé ìwòsàn, ilé ìtajà, àti ilé ìtàgé ti ṣubú.
rows.reference: Nugroho ṣàpèjúwe ìdibàjẹ́ náà bíi eyiti ''ó kọjá ààlà'' tí ó sì sọpé ẹgbẹ-ẹgbẹ̀rún àwọn ilé, àwọn ilé-ìwòsàn, àwọn ilé ìtaja ńlá àti àwọn ilé-ìtura niwọ́n ti wó lulẹ̀.

rows.output: Àwọn ara àwọn olùfaragbá kan ni a rí tí wọ́n wà lábẹ́ ìdọ̀tí àwọn ilé tí wọ́n ṣubú, ó sọ, ó sì fi kun pé 540 ènìyàn farapa àti 29 sì sọnù.
rows.reference: Àwọn àgọ́-ara ti àwọn tó farakó-áásá niwọ́n rí lábẹ́ àlàpà àwọn ilé tówó lulẹ̀, ní ó sọ, tí ó sì fi kún un pé ẹgbẹ̀tadínlọ́gọ́tá eniyan ló farapa tí ọ̀kaǹdińlọ́gbọ̀n sì ṣọnù.

rows.output: Nugroho sọ pé àwọn olùfaragbá àti ìbàjẹ́ náà lè pọ̀ sí i ní etíkun 300 km (190 maili) sí àríwá Palu, àgbègbè kan tí a ń pè ní Donggala, tí ó súnmọ́ ibi ìgbọ̀nsẹ̀ ìmìtà.
rows.reference: Nugroho sọpé àwọn tó farakó áásá àti ìdibàjẹ́ náà leè pọ̀jù bẹ́ẹ̀ lọ ní àwọn bèbè òkun  kílòmìtà 300 (máìlì 190) àríwá ti Palu, agbègbe kan tíwọn ńpè ní Donggala, eyiti ó súnmọ́ ààrin gungun agbára ilẹ̀ rírì náà.

rows.output: Ìbára-ẹni-sọ̀rọ̀ “pàdánù pátápátá pẹ̀lú ìsọfọ́” láti Donggala, Nugroho sọ.
rows.reference: Àwọn ìkànsíra-ẹni ni ''di àrọ aláìlẹ́sẹ̀ pátápátá láìsì ìròyìn kankan'' láti Donggala, ni Nugroho sọ.

rows.output: Ọ̀pọ̀lùpọ̀ ènìyàn tó lé ní ọgọ́rùn-ún mẹ́ta [300,000] ni wọ́n ń gbé níbẹ̀, àwọn ìjọsìn Pupa sọ nínú ọ̀rọ̀ kan, wọ́n sì sọ pé àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ àti àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ìsìn wọn ń lọ sí àwọn àgbègbè tí wọ́n kan.
rows.reference: Ó lé ni ẹgbẹ̀run lọ́nà ọ̀ọ́dún àwọn eniyan tó ńgbé níbẹ̀, ni Ẹgbẹ́ Aláàgbéléèbú Pupa sọ ninu gbólóhùn kan, tí wọn sì fi kún un pe àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ wọn àti awọn tó yọ̀ǹda ara wọn fún iṣẹ́ niwọ́n ti ńlọ sí àwọn agbègbe tí ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà ti wáyé.

rows.output: "Èyí ti jẹ́ ìbànújẹ́ báyìí, ṣùgbọ́n ó lè burú si."
rows.reference: ''Èyí ti di ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ àjálù buburú kan, ṣùgbọ́n o leè tún burú síwájú síi,'' ni o wí.

rows.output: Ẹ̀ka náà ni wọ́n fi ń ṣàrínwọ́n ní ọjọ́ Àbámẹ́ta fún pé wọn kò sọ fún àwọn ènìyàn pé ìjì líle kan ti kọlu Palu, bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ náà sọ pé àwọn igbi náà ti dé ní àkókò tí wọ́n ti gba ìkìlọ̀ náà.
rows.reference: Àjọ náà ni ọ̀pọ̀ bu ẹnu àtẹ́ lù lọ́jọ́ Àbámẹ́ta nitoripe kò fitó àwọn eniyan létí pe ìkún-omi tsunami ti kọlu Palu, botilẹjẹpe àwọn òṣiṣẹ́ sọpé àwọn ìjì òkun ti dé láàrin àkókò náà tí wọ́n ṣe àgbéjáde ìkìlọ̀ náà.

rows.output: Ní fídíò olùkópa tí a pín lórí àwọn ìkanni ìbáraẹniṣepọ̀, ọkùnrin kan tó wà lórí ilẹ̀kùú ilé kan lè gbọ́ tí ń pariwo pẹ̀lú ìdààmú pé ìjì líle ń bọ̀ sí àwọn ènìyàn tó wà ní ìsàlẹ̀ ọ̀nà.
rows.reference: Nínú àwòrán fídíò tí kìí ṣe ti akọṣẹ́mọṣẹ́ tíwọn pín lórì ojú-òpò ìbáṣepọ̀ ti ayelujara ni eniyan ti leè gbọ́ ti ọkùnrin kan tówà ní àjà òkè ilé kan ti ńpariwo ìkìlọ̀ nípa ti ìkún-omi tsunami tó ńbọ̀ sí àwọn eniyan tówà ní òpópóna nísàlẹ̀.

rows.output: Ní ìṣẹ́jú díẹ̀, òkùnkùn omi kan ń fọ́ sí etíkun, tí ń gbé àwọn ilé àti àwọn ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́ lọ.
rows.reference: Láàrin àwọn ìṣẹ́jú ògiri omi kan wó sí bèbè òkun náà, tí ó sì ńgbé àwọn ilé àti àwọn ọkọ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́ lọ.

rows.output: Reuters kò lè dáwọ́ dọ́gba pẹ̀lú fídíò náà lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀.
rows.reference: Reuters kò leè fi ìdí àwòrán fídíò náà múlẹ̀ lójú-ẹṣẹ̀ wípé ó jẹ òtítọ́.

rows.output: Ìwárìrì náà àti ìkún omi náà fa ìdààmú iná mànàmáná tó tóbi tó sì fà á tí ó ṣòro fún àwọn aláṣẹ láti ṣàkóso àwọn ìsapá ìgbálà.
rows.reference: Ilẹ̀ rírì àti ìkún-omi tsunami ṣe okùnfà àìsí iná mànàmáná eyiti ó gé àwọn okùn ìkànsí-ara-ẹni ní àyíká ìlú Palu tí ó sì jẹ́kí ó ṣòro fun àwọn aláṣẹ lati darí àwọn igbiyanju fún ìdóòlà-ẹ̀mí àwọn eniyan.

rows.output: Àwọn ọmọ ogun ti bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí í fi ọkọ̀ òfurufú ọkọ̀ òfurufú ránṣẹ́ láti Jakarta àti àwọn ìlú mìíràn, àwọn aláṣẹ sọ, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn tí wọ́n ń sá lọ́wọ́ sì nílò oúnjẹ àti àwọn ohun èlò pàtàkì mìíràn.
rows.reference: Àwọn ológun ti bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí fi àwọn ọkọ̀ òfurufú akẹ́rù ránṣẹ́ pẹ̀lú ìrànwọ́ lati Jarkata àti àwọn ìlú miran, ni àwọn aláṣẹ sọ, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn eniyan tíwọn sáré gbé kúro níbí ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà sì nílò oúnjẹ àti àwọn ohun tójẹ́ dandan miran.
Ibùdókọ̀ ọkọ̀ òfurufú ti ìlu náà ni wọ́n ti tún sí padà fún àwọn iṣẹ́ ìtura nìkan tí yóò sì wà ní títìpa títí di oṣù Ọ̀wàrà.

rows.output: Ààrẹ Joko Widodo ni wọ́n ṣètò láti lọ sí àwọn ibi ìpamọ́ àwọn tí wọ́n ti lé kúrò ní Palu ní ọjọ́ Sunday.
rows.reference: Ààrẹ Joko Widodo ni wọ́n ti ṣààtò rẹ̀ láti ṣàbẹ̀wò sí àwọn ibùdó tí àwọn tíwọn gbé kuro níbi ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà lọ́jọ́ Àìkú.

rows.output: Ìṣàn omi Indonesia ti pọ̀ sí i ju 800 lọ.
rows.reference: Iye eniyan tóku nínu Ìkún-omi Tsunami ti Indonesia ti fò sòke ju ẹ̣gbẹ̀rin lọ

rows.output: Ó burú jù.
rows.reference: Ó burú púpọ̀

rows.output: Nígbà tí àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ Vision Àgbáyé láti Donggala ti dé Palu ní ààbò, níbi tí àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ náà ti ń gbé níbikíbi tí wọ́n ti ṣètò ní ilé wọn, wọ́n kọjá àwọn ibi ìbàjẹ́ nígbà tí wọ́n ń lọ, Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Doseba sọ.
rows.reference: Nigbati àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ World Vision láti Donggala ti dé ìlú Palu lálàáfía, níbití àwọn abániṣiṣẹ́ tí ńgbé nínú àwọn àgọ́ oní-tapóólì tí wọn ṣe àtòpọ̀ rẹ̀ ninu ọgbà ọ́fíìsì wọn, wọ́n gba àwọn ibi ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ àjálù náà kọjá lójú ọ̀nà, ni Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Doseba sọ.

rows.output: Wọ́n sọ fún mi pé wọ́n rí ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ilé tí wọ́n ti bàjẹ́.
rows.reference: ''Wọ́n sọ fuńmi wipe àwọn rí ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn ilé tí wọn ti parun, ni ó wí.

rows.output: Ó burú jù.
rows.reference: Ó burú púpọ̀ ju.

rows.output: Láàárín ìgbà tí àwọn ẹgbẹ́ ìrìnnà bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí í ṣe àwọn ìṣe tí ó le koko láti bẹ̀rẹ̀ ìrìnnà ìrìnnà, àwọn kan ń bẹ̀rù pé àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ìrìnnà àjèjì tí wọ́n ní ìmọ̀ jinlẹ̀ ni a ń dènà láti rin ìrìn àjò lọ sí Palu.
rows.reference: Àní bí àwọn ẹgbẹ́ onírànlọ́wọ́ ti bẹ̀rẹ̀ àwọn ìrìn àìsinmi fún bíbẹ̀rẹ̀ àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ láti pèsè ìtura fún àjálù, àwọn kan fẹ̀sùn kan pé wọ́n dínà mọ́ àwọn oníṣẹ́ ìrànwọ́ láti ilẹ̀-òkèèrè láti máṣe rin ìrìn-àjò sí Palu.

rows.output: Gẹ́gẹ́ bí òfin ilẹ̀ Indonesia ṣe sọ, ìnáwọ̀, ohun èlò, àti ìṣé oko lè bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí í ṣàn wá láti ilẹ̀ òkèèrè tí a bá kéde ibi ìṣòro kan sípò àgbègbè ìṣòro orílẹ̀-èdè.
rows.reference: Gẹ́gẹ́bí àwọn òfin ilẹ̀ Indonesia ti wí, fífúnnilówó, àwọn ìpèsè àti fífúnnilóṣìṣẹ́ láti òkè-òkun leè bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí wọlé nìkan bí wọ́n bá kéde ibi ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ kan bíi agbègbè ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ àjálù ti orilẹ-ede.

rows.output: Ó sì ṣẹlẹ̀ báyìí.
rows.reference: Síbẹ̀ èyí kò tìí ṣẹlẹ̀.

rows.output: "Ó ṣì jẹ́ ìṣòro ìjọba ìpínlẹ̀," ni Aulia Arriani, agbẹnusọ fún Ìjọ Àwọ̀ Pupa ti ilẹ̀ Indonesia sọ.

rows.output: Ní báyìí, Ṣáínà ṣe àgbékalẹ̀ ètò rẹ̀ ní ọdún tó kọjá: ó ń wá láti jẹ́ No.1 nínú ìmúṣẹ AI nípa 2030.

rows.output: "Ìdá méjì owó ìwádì AI yóò jẹ́ ìbèrè rere, níwọ̀n bí gbogbo orílẹ̀-èdè mìíràn ti jẹ́ ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ìjìnlé lẹ́yìn U.S., àti pé a ń wá ìmúpadàbọ̀sípò tó ń bọ̀ nínú AI," ni Lee sọ.

rows.output: Ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ owó náà lè mú kí ìṣírí náà pọ̀ sí i pé àṣeyọrí AI tó tóbi jù lọ ní orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà yóò jẹ́ ní ọjọ́ iwájú, Lee sọ fún CNBC nínú ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò kan ní ọ̀sẹ̀ yìí.

rows.output: "Mo wá l'ónìí láti dìbò fún ọjọ́ iwájú orílẹ̀-èdè náà, fún àwọn ọ̀dọ́ ní Masedóníà kí wọn lè gbé ní òmìnira lábẹ́ àpáta Ìparapọ̀ Yúróòpù nítorí pé ó túmọ̀ sí ìgbé ayé ààbò fún gbogbo wa," ni Olivera Georgijevska, 79, sọ ní Skopje.
rows.reference: Mó wá lóòní láti di ìbò fún ọjọ́ iwájú orilẹ-ede náà, fún àwọn ọ̀dọ́ ní Masidóníà kí wọ́n leè máa gbé ní òmìnira lábẹ́ agboòrùn ti Àjọ Àwọn Orilẹ-ede Yuroopu nitoripe ó túmọ̀ sí àwọn ìgbésí ayé aláìléwu púpọ̀ síi fún gbogbo wa,'' gẹgẹ bíi Olivera Georgijevska, ẹni ọdún mọ́kàndínlọ́gọ́rin ṣe sọ, ní ìlú Skopje.

rows.output: Bó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé kò jẹ́ ìdájì, àwọn ọmọ ilé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin tó pọ̀ jù lọ ti sọ pé wọn yóò tẹ̀lé àbájáde ìdìbò náà, èyí tó mú kí ó jẹ́ ìpinnu tó ṣe pàtàkì.
rows.reference: Botilẹjepe kìí ṣe àdéhùn tó ńfipá múni lábẹ̀ òfin, àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ ilé ìgbìmọ aṣojú-ṣòfin tí ó tóníye ti sọpé àwọn faramọ̀ àbájáde ìbò náà láti ṣeé ní eyiti ẹnu rẹ̀ múlẹ̀.

rows.output: Ìyípadà orúkọ náà yóò nílò ìdá méjìlá nínú mẹ́ta nínú ilé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin.
rows.reference: Ìyípadà orúkọ náà yóò nílò ìdá méjì tópọ̀jù ninu ìdá mẹ́ta àwọn ọmọ ilé ìgbìmọ aṣojú-ṣòfin.

rows.output: Ìgbìmọ̀ ìdìbò ìpínlẹ̀ náà sọ pé kò sí ìrònú nípa àìṣedéédé ní aago 1 òwọ́.
rows.reference: Ìgbìmọ̀ amúṣẹ́ṣe lori ìdìbò ti orilẹ-ede náà sọpé kòsí àwọn ìròyìn àìṣedéédéé kankan títí aago méjì ọ̀sán.

rows.output: Síbẹ̀síbẹ̀, ìdìbò náà jẹ́ 16%, ní ìfiwéra pẹ̀lú 34% nínú ìdìbò ilé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin tó kẹ́yìn ní ọdún 2016 nígbà tí 66% àwọn olùdìbò tí wọ́n forúkọ sílẹ̀ dibo.
rows.reference: Bótiwùkórí, ìjáde-dìbò dúró ní ìdá mẹ́rìndínlógún ninu ìdá ọgọ́ọ̀run, bí a ṣafiwé rẹ̀ sì ìdá mẹ́rìnlélọ́gbọ̀n ti inú ìdìbò àwọn aṣojú-ṣòfin tókọjá lọ́dún 2016 nigbati ìdá mẹ́rìndínláàádọ́rin àwọn olùdìbò tó forúkọ sílẹ̀ fi ìwé àmútẹkasí láti dìbo wọn sílẹ̀.

rows.output: "Mo jáde láti dibo nítorí àwọn ọmọ mi, ibi wa ni Yúróòpù," ni Gjose Tanevski, 62, olùdìbò ní olú ìlú, Skopje.
rows.reference: ''Mo jáde síta láti dìbò nitori àwọn ọmọ mi, ipò wa wà ninu Yuroopu,'' gẹgẹ bíi Gjose Tanevski, ẹni ọdún méjìlélọ́gọ́ta, olùdìbo kan ní olù-ìlú náà, Skopje ṣe sọ.

rows.output: Mambobin Majalisar ta Welsh suna damuwa game da "yadda za su yi kama da 'yan wasan kwaikwayo"
rows.reference: Welsh AMs ta damu game da 'yadda ake zama kamar wawaye'

rows.output: Akwai damuwa a tsakanin wasu mambobin majalisar a kan shawarar cewa taken su ya canza zuwa MWPs (Mamba na Majalisar Welsh ta Parliament).
rows.reference: Akwai tsoron haɗari a tsakanin wasu AMs a bisa shawarar canza muƙaminsu zuwa MWPs (Mamban Majalisar Dokoki ta Welsh).

rows.output: Ya taso ne saboda shirye-shiryen canza sunan majalisar zuwa Majalisar Welsh.
rows.reference: Abin ya tashi ne saboda shirye-shirye na canza sunan taron zuwa Majalisar Dokoki ta Welsh.

rows.output: AMs a faɗin fagen siyasa suna damuwa cewa hakan na iya jawo wa su kunya.
rows.reference: AM a ɓangaren siyasa sun damu ƙwarai don zai iya haifar da ba’a.

rows.output: Wani dan jam'iyyar Labour ya ce, "muna damuwa cewa yana da kama da Twp da Pwp."
rows.reference: Wani AM na Jam’iyyar Labour ya ce ƙungiyar ta damu "yana rauji da Twp da kuma Pwp."

rows.output: Ga masu karatunta a wajen Wales: A cikin Welsh twp yana nufin daft da pwp yana nufin kwaya.
rows.reference: Don masu karatu a wajen Wales: A cikin Welsh twp yana nufin hauka kuma pwp yana nufin kashi.

rows.output: Wani memban jam'iyyar Plaid ya ce dukkan jam'iyyar "ba ta yi farin ciki ba" kuma ya ba da wasu shawarwari.
rows.reference: Wani Plaid AM ya ce gungun gaba ɗaya “ba su ji daɗi ba” kuma ya ba da shawarar zaɓuɓɓuka.

rows.output: Wani dan jam'iyyar Conservative na Welsh ya ce, "muna da ra'ayi mai bude ido" game da canjin sunan, amma ya lura cewa yana da guntu a cikin magana daga MWP zuwa Muppet.
rows.reference: Wani mai ra’ayin riƙau na Welsh ya ce gungun “ba shi da wani abu a zuciya” game da canza sunan, amma ya lura wani ɗan gajeren bayani ne daga MWP zuwa Muppet.

rows.output: A cikin wannan mahallin, harafin Welsh w ana furta shi kamar yadda ake furta harafin Yorkshire na Ingilishi.
rows.reference: A wannan bigiren, ana furta harafin w na Welsh ne kwatankwacin furucin Turanci na Yorshire na harafin u.

rows.output: Hukumar Majalisar, wadda a halin yanzu tana rubuta dokar gabatar da canje-canje na suna, ta ce: "Shawarwarin karshe kan duk wani bayani na abin da ake kira mambobin Majalisar zai dogara ne ga mambobin kansu."
rows.reference: Hukumar Majalisar, wanda a yanzu haka ke rubuta daftarin dokar don gabatar da canje-canjen sunan, ta ce:  “Hukuncin ƙarshe a kan kowaɗanne abubuwa masu bayyanarwa abin da ake kiran mambobi na Majalisar zai kasance kuwa wani batu ne don mambobin da kansu.”

rows.output: Dokar Gwamanin Wales ta 2017 ta ba Majalisar Welsh ikon canza sunan ta.
rows.reference: Dokar Gwamnatin Welsh ta 2017 ta ba wa majalisar Welsh iko na canza sunanta.

rows.output: A watan Yuni, Hukumar ta buga sakamakon tattaunawa a bainar jama'a kan shawarwarin da ta samu, wanda ya nuna goyon bayan kira majalisar da Welsh Parliament.
rows.reference: A cikin Yuni, Hukumar ta wallafa sakamako na wata tattaunawar jama’a a kan ƙudurorin wadanda suka sami babban goyon baya don kiran majalisar Majalisar Dokokin Welsh.

rows.output: A kan batun sunan AMs, hukumar ta fi son mambobin majalisar Welsh ko WMPs, amma zaɓin MWP ya sami mafi yawan goyon baya a wani bincike na jama'a.
rows.reference: A kan batun sunan AMs ɗin, Hukumar ta fi son Mambobin Majalisar Dokokin Welsh ko WMPs, amma zaɓin MWP ya sami mafi goyon bayan a cikin wata tattaunawar jama’a.

rows.output: AMs suna bayyana wasu zaɓuɓɓuka, amma ƙalubalen cim ma yarjejeniya na iya zama damuwa ga Shugaban Majalisar, Elin Jones, wanda ake sa ran zai gabatar da kundin tsarin mulki kan canje-canje cikin makwanni.
rows.reference: A fili AMs suna ba da shawarar wasu zaɓuɓɓuka ne, amma gwagwarmayar isa ga matsaya za ta iya zama mai wahala ga Jami’i Mai Kula, Elin Jones, wanda ake tsammanin za ta mila daftarin dokar a kan canje-canje a cikin makonni.

rows.output: Dokar gyarawa za ta hada da wasu canje-canje a yadda majalisar ke aiki, ciki har da dokokin da suka shafi cire mambobi da kuma tsarin tsarin kwamitocin.
rows.reference: Dokar a kan canje-canjen za su haɗa da sauran canje-canje na yadda majalisar ke aiki, da ya haɗa da ƙa’idoji a kan ayyana rashin cancanta na AMs da kuma tsara tsari na kwamitin.

rows.output: AMs za su sami kuri'ar karshe kan tambayar abin da za su kira lokacin da suka tattauna dokar.
rows.reference: AMs za su sami kaɗa kuri’ar karshe a kan batun abin da za a kira su da shi a yayin da suka yi mahawarar dokar.

rows.output: Macedonawa za su je rumfunan zaɓe a zaben da za a yi kan canza sunan ƙasar.
rows.reference: ‘Yan Macedonia sun tafi yin zaɓuɓɓuka a cikin zaɓen raba gardama a kan canza sunan kasar

rows.output: Masu jefa kuri'a za su yi zabe a ranar Lahadi kan ko za su canza sunan kasar su zuwa "Jamhuriyyar Makedoniya ta Arewa."
rows.reference: Masu kada kuri’a za su yi zaɓe a kan ko su canza sunan kasarsu zuwa “Jamhuriyyar Macedonia ta Arewa.”

rows.output: An kafa kuri'ar jama'a ne domin magance takaddama da ta dore tsakanin kasashe makwabta, Girka, wanda ke da lardi mai suna Macedonia.
rows.reference: An saita sanannen zaɓen ne don wani ƙoƙari na warware wani rikicin da ya yi shekara da shekara tare da makwaɓciyar ƙasa ta Greece, wadda ke da lardinta da ake kira Macedonia.

rows.output: Athens ta yi ta ce wa maƙwabcinta na arewa cewa sunan ƙasar na nuna da'awarta kan ƙasar ta, kuma ta yi adawa da neman shiga EU da NATO.
rows.reference: Athens ta jima tana jajircewa cewa sunan makwaɓciyarta daga arewaci yana wakiltar wani ƙorafi ne a kan yankinta kuma ta sha maimaita ƙin neman matsayin mamba a Tarayyar Turai da Ƙungiyar Ƙawance ta NATO.

rows.output: Shugaban Macedoniya Gjorge Ivanov, wanda ya yi adawa da zaben kan canza sunan, ya ce zai yi watsi da zaben.
rows.reference: Shugaban Ƙasar Macedonia Gjorge Ivanov, wani mai adawa da tsarin zaɓen kai tsaye a kan canza sunan, ya ce zai yi watsi da zaɓen.

rows.output: Duk da haka, masu goyon bayan zaben sun hada da Firaminista Zoran Zaev, suna jayayya cewa canjin sunan kawai farashin da za a biya don shiga EU da NATO.
rows.reference: Amma, masu goyon bayan zaɓen raba gardamar, da suka haɗa da Firaminista Zoran Zaev, suna mahawara cewa canza sunan wani ɗan aiki ne da dole a yi don a shiga Tarayyar Turai da Ƙungiyar Ƙawance ta NATO.

rows.output: Kukan Cocin St. Martin's Sun Tsaya a Tsayayye yayin da Cocin a Harlem ke Gwagwarmaya
rows.reference: Ƙararrawar St. Martin's Sun yi Shiru Saboda Majami’u a cikin Harlem suna cikin Gwargwarmaya

rows.output: "A tarihi, tsofaffin mutanen da na yi magana da su sun ce akwai mashaya da coci a kowane lungu," in ji Mista Adams.
rows.reference: “A tarihi, tsofaffin mutanen da na yi magana da su sun ce akwai wata mashaya da wata majami’a a kowace kusurwa,” Inji Mista Adams.

rows.output: "A yau, babu komai."
rows.reference: “A yau kuwa, babu ko ɗaya.”

rows.output: Ya ce bacewar mashaya ba abu ne mai ban mamaki ba.
rows.reference: Ya ce ɓacewa ta mashayun abu ne na fahimta.

rows.output: "Mutane suna mu'amala ta hanyar daban" yanzu, ya ce.
rows.reference: “Mutane suna shaƙatawa ta wata hanya daban” a ranakun nan, injin shi.

rows.output: "Kantuna ba wuraren da ake taruwa a cikin al'umma ba ne inda mutane ke zuwa akai-akai."
rows.reference: “Mashayu yanzu ba ɗakuna ne da ke makwaɓta ba inda mutane ke zuwa a-kai-a-kai.”

rows.output: Game da majami'u, yana damuwa cewa kudi daga sayar da kadarori ba zai dade kamar yadda shuwagabanni ke tsammani ba, "kuma ba da daɗewa ba za su dawo inda suka fara."
rows.reference: A game da majami’un, ya damu cewa kuɗin da ake samu daga sayar da kadarori ba za su jima idan kamar yadda shugabanni ke tsammani ba, “kuma nan ba da jimawa ba ko daga baya za su dawo idan suka fara.”

rows.output: Coci, ya kara da cewa, za a iya maye gurbinsa da gine-ginen gidan zama da kuma gidajen da aka cika da irin mutanen da ba za su taimaka wa sauran majami'un da ke cikin unguwar ba.
rows.reference: Ya ƙara da cewa, za a musanya majami’u da gine-ginen gidaje tare da manyan wurarene masu cike da irin mutane waɗanda ba za su taimaka ga sauran wuraren samun mafaka na makwaɓta.

rows.output: "Yawaitar mutanen da ke sayen gidajen haya a cikin wadannan gine-gine za su kasance fari ne," ya ce, "sannu kuma za su hanzarta ranar da wadannan majami'u za su rufe gaba daya saboda ba abu ne mai yiwuwa ba cewa yawancin mutanen da za su koma wajen zama a cikin wadannan gidajen haya za su zama mambobin wadannan majami'u."
rows.reference: “Mafi yawan mutane da za su sayi manyan wurare a cikin waɗannan gine-ginen za su kasance farar fata ne,” inji shi, “don haka kuwa za su gaggauta ranar da za a ce waɗannan majami’u sun rufe gaba ɗaya saboda akwai yiwuwar mafi yawanci waɗannan mutane da suka motsa cikin wadannan manyan wuraren su zama mambobi na waɗannan majami’u.”

rows.output: Dukkan majami'u biyu an gina su ne da jama'a masu launin fata kafin Harlem ya zama birni mai rinjaye na baƙar fata - Majami'ar Al'umma a shekara ta 1870, St. Martin's shekaru goma bayan haka.
rows.reference: Duka majami’un guda biyu farar fata ne suka gina su kafin Harlem ta zama alƙaryar baƙaƙen fata - Al’ummar da ke Alƙaryar a 1870, shekaru goma bayan St. Martin’s.

rows.output: Ƙungiyar Methodist ta farko ta bar a cikin shekarun 1930.
rows.reference: Asalin farar fata mahalarta ‘yan Methodist sun fita ne a cikin shekaru na 1930.

rows.output: jama'ar baƙar fata da suke ibadar kusa sun ɗauki ginin.
rows.reference: Wani taron masu ibada baƙaƙe da ke yin ibada a kusa suka mallaki ginin.

rows.output: An karɓi St. Martin ta wani gungu na baƙar fata a ƙarƙashin jagorancin Rev. John Howard Johnson, wanda ya jagoranci yajin aikin masu sayar da kaya a kan titin 125, babbar hanya ta siyayya a Harlem, waɗanda suka yi adawa da ɗaukar ma'aikata ko haɓaka baƙar fata.
rows.reference: Taron baƙaƙen fata masu ibada ne suka karɓe ragamar St. Martin’s a ƙarƙashin Rabaran John Howard Johnson, wanda ya jagoranci ‘yan kasuwa da su ƙaurace ma sayen kaya a kan layi na 125, wani babban layin yin sayayya a Harlem, wanda ya jajirce a wajen yin hayar ma’aikata ko tallafawa baƙaƙen fata.

rows.output: Wani wuta a shekarar 1939 ya lalata ginin sosai, amma yayin da Father Johnson's parishioners suka shirya sake gina shi, sun ba da umarnin yin carillon.
rows.reference: Wata gobara a cikin 1939 ta lalata ginin sosai, amma kamar yadda mabiyan Fada Johnson suka yi shirye-shirye na sake ginin, su ne suka buɗe kayan kiɗan majami’ar.

rows.output: An yi wa Rev. David Johnson, ɗan Father Johnson da magaji a St. Martin's, ya yi alfahari da kiran carillon "agogo na talaka."
rows.reference: Rabaran David Johnson, dan Fada Johnson da wanda ya gaje shi a St. Martin's, a cikin alfahari ya kiran kayan kiɗan majami’ar “ƙararrawowin mutane talakawa.”

rows.output: Kwararre wanda ya buga carillon a watan Yuli ya kira shi wani abu daban: "Kasadar al'adu" da "kayan tarihi da ba za a iya maye gurbinsa ba."
rows.reference: Ƙwararren da ya kaɗa ƙararrawar a watan Yuli ya kira shi da wani abu daban: “Wata ajiyayyar dukiyar al’ada” da “wani kayan tarihi da ba za a iya maida gurbinsa ba.”

rows.output: Ƙwararre, Tiffany Ng daga Jami'ar Michigan, ta lura cewa ita ce motar farko a duniya da ta kasance tana wasa da mai kida baƙar fata, Dionisio A. Lind, wanda ya koma babban motan a Cocin Riverside shekaru 18 da suka wuce.
rows.reference: Kwararren, Tiffany Ng na Jami’ar Michigan, har ila yau ya lura cewa shi ne kayan kiɗa na farko a duniya da wani mawaki baƙar fata ya rera, wato Dionisio A. Lind, wanda ya motsa babban kayan kiɗan a Majami’ar Riverside shekaru 18 da suka wuce.

rows.output: Mista Merriweather ya ce St. Martin's ba su maye gurbinsa ba.
rows.reference: Mista Merriweather ya ce St. Martin's ɗin ba ta musanya shi ba.

rows.output: Abin da ya faru a St. Martin a cikin watanni da suka gabata ya kasance labari mai rikitarwa na masu gine-gine da masu aikin gini, wasu da masu kula da cocin suka kawo, wasu kuma da cocin Episcopal.
rows.reference: Abin da ya bayyana a St. Martin’s a ‘yan watanni da suka wuce ya zama wani labari mai ruɗarwa na masana zane da ‘yan kwangila, wasu da shugabannin majami’ar da ba su da ilimi suka kawo, sauran kuwa daga ikon babban limamin ‘yan Episcopal.

rows.output: Mataimakan limamin cocin - wanda ya kunshi shugabanni masu zaman kansu, sun rubuta majami'ar a watan Yuli da damuwoyi cewa majami'ar "za ta yi ƙoƙarin watsar da farashi" ga majami'ar, duk da cewa majami'ar ba ta shiga cikin daukan masu zanen gine-gine da masu aikin da majami'ar ta aika ba.
rows.reference: Sai kwamitin vestry ɗin - hukumar gudanar da yankin iyakar majami’ar, da ta haɗa da shugabanni da ba su da ilimi - sun rubuta wa babban limamin a Yuli da damuwowinsu cewa yankin iyakar majami’ar “zai nemi mika kuɗaɗen da aka kashe” zuwa kwamitin vestry ɗin, duk da cewa ba a sa kwamitin vestry ɗin ba a yin hayar masu zanen da ‘yan kwangilar da yankin iyakar majami’ar suka sa ba.

rows.output: Wasu ’yan cocin sun yi korafi kan rashin gaskiya a kan wajen cocin.
rows.reference: Wasu mabiya sun yi ƙorafi game da rashin bayyana abin da aka yi ta ɓangaren yankin iyakar majami’ar.

rows.output: Wani kaguwa ya raunata yaro mai shekaru 13 a lokacin da yake nutsewa don lobster a California
rows.reference: Babban kifin teku ya raunata mai iyon neman lobster ɗan shekaru 13 a California

rows.output: An yi wa wani yaro mai shekaru 13 hari da wani kifi a ranar Asabar yayin da yake nutsewa don kaguwa a California a ranar farko ta kakar kaguwa, jami'an sun ce.
rows.reference: Wani babban kifin teku ya kai hari da raunata wani yaro mai shekaru 13 a ranar Asabar a lokacin da yake iyon neman losbter a cikin California a ranar buɗe lokacin lobster, kamar yadda jami’ai suka ce.

rows.output: An kai hari ne da misalin karfe 7 na safe a kusa da Beacon's Beach a Encinitas.
rows.reference: Harin ya faru ne kawai kafin ƙarfe 7 na safe kusa da Bakin Tekun Beacon a cikin Encinitas.

rows.output: Chad Hammel ya gaya wa KSWB-TV a San Diego cewa ya yi iyo da abokai na kusan rabin sa'a a ranar Asabar da safe lokacin da ya ji yaron yana kuka yana neman taimako, sannan ya shiga cikin gungu don taimakawa su fitar da shi daga cikin ruwan.
rows.reference: Chad Hammel ya fada wa gidan talabijin na KSWB-TV a San Diego yana iyo ne tare da abokansa na kusan rabin sa’a a ranar Asabar da safe a lokacin da ya ji yaron yana kururuwa shi ke nan sai ya nufi wurin tare da wani gungun mutane don su jawo shi waje daga ruwan.

rows.output: Hammel ya ce da farko ya yi tunanin kawai jin daɗin kama lobster ne, amma sai ya gane cewa "ya yi ihu, 'Na yi katsi!
rows.reference: Hammel ya ce da farko ya ɗauka wata annishuwa ce ta kama wani losbter, amma shi ke nan sai ya “gano cewa ihu yake yi, ‘An cije ni!

rows.output: Na yi kukan da na yi!
rows.reference: An cije ni!’

rows.output: An buɗe dukkan ƙashinsa," in ji Hammel da ya lura da yaron da ya isa.
rows.reference: An buɗe kashin kafaɗarsa gaba ɗaya,” inji Hammel da ya gani a lokacin da isa wurin yaron.

rows.output: "Na yi ihu ga kowa da kowa ya fita daga ruwan: 'Akwai wani kaguwa a cikin ruwan!'" Hammel ya kara.
rows.reference: “Na yi ihu ga kowa don su fita daga ruwan. Hammel ya ƙara da cewa, ‘Akwai babban kifin teku a cikin ruwan!”

rows.output: An tashi yaron zuwa Asibitin Yara na Rady a San Diego inda yake cikin mawuyacin hali.
rows.reference: An ɗauki yaron a cikin jirgin sama zuwa Asibitin Yara na Rady da ke cikin San Diego inda aka jera shi a yanayi mai tsanani.

rows.output: An samu hari daga wata dabba da ba a san ta ba.
rows.reference: Ba a san irie-iren jinsunan babban kifin tekun da ya yi wannan harin ba.

rows.output: Jami'in tsaron ruwa Capt. Larry Giles ya bayyana a wani taro na manema labarai cewa an ga wani kifin kifi a yankin makwanni kaɗan kafin, amma an gano ba wani nau'in kifin da ke da hatsari ba.
rows.reference: Kyaftin Larry Giles mai kula da rayuwa ya ce a gaban maneman labarai cewa an ga wani babban kifin teku a cikin yankin ‘yan makonni baya, amma an ƙudurta cewa ba daga wani jinsuna ne babban kifi mai haɗari ne ba.

rows.output: Giles ya kara wa wanda aka azabtar da shi raunuka masu tsanani a yankin kirjinsa.

rows.output: A matsayin wani ɓangare na babban tashin hankali zuwa kasuwar kyawu ta Birtaniya ta £2.8bn, wadda ke ci gaba da girma yayin da sayar da kayan kwalliya da kayan gida ke komawa baya, manyan sassan kyawu za a gwada a cikin shaguna 11 a faɗin ƙasar, kuma za a kai su wasu shaguna a shekarar gaba idan ya yi nasara.
rows.reference: A matsayin ɓangaren shiga cikin kasuwar kwalliya ta Birtaniyya ta Fam biliyan 2.8, wadda ke ci gaba da haɓaka duk da cewa cinikayyar ado da kayan gida ta sami koma baya, za a gwada manyan ɓangarorin kwalliya a shaguna 11 na kasar kuma a ɗauke su zuwa ƙarin shaguna a shekara mai zuwa idan abin ya ci wata nasara.

rows.output: Zuba jari a cikin kayan kwalliyance ya zo ne a lokacin da manyan shagunan sayayya ke neman hanyoyin amfani da sararin samu na shiryayye da aka yi amfani da su a baya don na'urar TV, microwave, da kayan gida.

rows.output: Sainsbury's ya ce zai ninka girman kayan kwalliyar sa har zuwa samfuran 3,000, ciki har da alamomi kamar Revlon, Essie, Tweezerman da Dr. PawPaw a karon farko.

rows.output: Kasuwancin da ake da su daga L'Oreal, Maybelline da Burt's Bees za su sami ƙarin sarari tare da wuraren da aka yi wa lakabi irin na waɗanda ke cikin shagunan kamar Boots.

rows.output: Kantin sayen kayan abinci kuma yana sake fara samar da jerin kayansa na kayan kwalliyarsu, don haka yawancin kayan suna da amfani ga masu cin ganyayyaki - wani abu da ake buƙatar matasa masu siye sosai.

rows.output: Bugu da ƙari, mai sayar da turare mai kamfanin Fragrance Shop zai gwada shaguna a cikin shagunan Sainsbury guda biyu, na farko da aka bude a Croydon, kudu London, makonnin da suka gabata, yayin da na biyu ya bude a Selly Oak, Birmingham, a karshen wannan shekarar.

rows.output: Siyan kan layi da kuma sauyin zuwa sayen ƙananan kayan abinci a kullum a shagunan da ke kusa yana nufin cewa manyan shagunan suna buƙatar yin ƙarin aiki don shawo kan mutane su ziyarci.

rows.output: Mike Coupe, shugaban kamfanin Sainsbury's, ya ce shagunan za su yi kama da shagunan sasanta a hankali yayin da kamfanin ke kokarin kare kansa daga masu rangwame Aldi da Lidl da karfafa ayyukan da ba na abinci ba.

rows.output: Sainsbury's ya fara sanya wuraren Argos a cikin ɗaruruwan shaguna kuma ya gabatar da wasu wuraren da aka sani da Habitats tun da ya sayi dukkan jerin biyu shekaru biyu da suka wuce, wanda ya ce ya kara sayar da kayan abinci da kuma sa sayen ya zama mai riba.

rows.reference: Ganin jijjigar ƙasa da Indonesiya ta saba gani, ƙasar ta zama ta yi mummunan rashin shiryawa don bala’in rayuwa.

rows.output: Yayin da an gina sansanonin tsunami a Aceh, ba su da yawa a kan sauran gabar teku.
rows.reference: Duk da cewa an gina matsugunan Tsunami a cikin Aceh, ba su zama abin da ake iya gani a yankunan da ke kusa da bakin ruwa ba.

rows.output: Rashin bayyana siren na tsunami a Palu, duk da cewa an yi gargadi, mai yiwuwa ya kara haifar da asarar rayuka.
rows.reference: Rashin jiniyar gargarɗin tsunami da ya fito a fili a cikin Palu, duk da cewa wani gargaɗi yana aiki, zai iya yiwuwa shi ne ya ba da gudunmawa ga rasa rayuwa.

rows.output: A lokacin da ya fi kyau, tafiya tsakanin tsibiran Indonesia da yawa na da wahala.
rows.reference: A lokuta mafiya kyau, bulaguro tsakanin tsibiran Indonesiya masu yawa yana da ƙalubale.

rows.output: Bala'o'i na halitta suna sa ayyukan sufuri su zama masu rikitarwa.
rows.reference: Haɗuran da Allah ya aiko sukan sa rabe-raben kayan buƙata ya zama da wahala sosai.

rows.output: Jirgin asibiti da aka sanya a Lombok domin kula da wadanda suka jikkata a cikin girgizar kasa, yana kan hanyar zuwa Palu, amma zai dau lokaci akalla kwanaki uku kafin ya isa wurin bala'in.
rows.reference: Wani asibitin jirgin ruwa da aka ajiye a cikin Lombok yana kan hanyarsa ta zuwa Palu don kula da waɗanda girgizar ƙasar ta shafa, amma zai ɗauki aƙalla kwanaki uku kafin isa wurin sabon bala’in.

rows.output: Shugaban Joko Widodo ya sa ya zama babban jigo na yakin neman zabensa na inganta abubuwan more rayuwa na Indonesia da suka lalacewa, kuma ya kashe kudi mai yawa a kan hanyoyin mota da hanyoyin jirgin kasa.
rows.reference: Shugaba Ƙasa Joko Widodo ya maida inganta gine-ginen Indonesiya da suka lalace abin da ya sa a gaba na kamfe ɗin zaɓensa, kuma ya zuba kuɗi mai yawa a kan hanyoyi da hanyoyin jirgin ƙasa.

rows.output: Amma rashin isassun kuɗin shiga ya damu da gwamnatin Mista Joko yayin da yake fuskantar sake zaben shekara mai zuwa.
rows.reference: Amma rashin isassun kuɗaɗe ya addabi gwamnatin Mista Joko a lokacin da yake fuskantar sake zaɓe a shekara mai zuwa.

rows.output: Mista Joko kuma yana fuskantar matsi daga tashin hankali na addini da ya dore a Indonesia, inda mabiya mafi yawan musulmin kasar suka rungumi wani salo na musamman na wannan addini.
rows.reference: Haka kuma Mista Joko yana fuskantar matsi daga tashin-tashina bambanci addini da ya-ƙi-ci-ya-ƙi-cinyewa, inda mamobin Musulmai da suka fi rinjaye suka karɓi nau’in addini tsatstsaura.

rows.output: Fiye da mutane 1,000 ne suka mutu, kuma dubunnan sun rasa matsugunansu a lokacin da gungun Kiristoci da Musulmai suka yi faɗa a kan titi, suna amfani da wukake, kibiyoyi, da kuma wasu makaman da ba su da kyau.
rows.reference: An kashe fiye da mutane 1,000 kuma dubun-dubata sun rasa matsugunai daga gidajensu kamar yadda ‘yan daba Kirista da Musulmai ke ta yaƙi a kan tituna, suna masu yin amfani da adduna, kwari da baka, da sauran muggan makamai.

rows.output: Kalli: Kwallon Liverpool ta Daniel Sturridge ta yi daidai da Chelsea
rows.reference: Kalli: Daniel Sturridge na Liverpool ya jawo kunnen doki da  Chelsea

rows.output: Daniel Sturridge ya ceci Liverpool daga rashin nasara a gasar Premier da Chelsea da ci a minti na 89 a ranar Asabar a Stamford Bridge a Landan.
rows.reference: Daniel Sturridge ya kare Liverpool daga wani wasa kofin ƙalubale na Premier League inda ya yi hasara ga Chelsea tare da ci a cikin mintina na 89 a ranar Asabar a Stamford Bridge a cikin Landan.

rows.output: Sturridge ya karɓi wando daga Xherdan Shaqiri yayin da yake kusan mita 30 daga ragar kwallon Chelsea, yayin da ƙungiyar ta ke bin 1-0.
rows.reference: Sturridge ya karɓi wani turo ƙwallo daga Xherdan Shaqiri kusan yadina 30 a waje daga cin Chelsea tare da ‘yan ƙungiyarsa da suke biye ci 1 da 0.

rows.output: Ya tuntubi ƙwallon zuwa hagu kafin ya ciro harbin zuwa kusurwar nesa.
rows.reference: Ya taɓa ƙwallon zuwa hagun ɗinsa kafin ya yi wani bugu zuwa matsaya mai nisa.

rows.output: Ƙoƙarin ya yi sama da akwati yayin da yake tafiya zuwa kusurwar dama ta sama ta hanyar harsashi.
rows.reference: Ƙoƙarin ya ɗagu sama da akwatin inda ya gangara zuwa saman kusurwar dama na ragar.

rows.output: Kwallon ta faɗi a kan tsalle Kepa Arrizabalaga sannan ta fado cikin ragon.
rows.reference: Daga ƙarshe ƙwallon ta faɗo a saman Kepa Arrizabalaga mai tsalle inda kuma ta faɗa cikin ragar.

rows.output: "Kawai na yi ƙoƙarin shiga wannan matsayi, don samun ƙwallon kuma 'yan wasa kamar Shaq koyaushe suna wasa gaba da yawa, don haka kawai na yi ƙoƙarin ƙera lokaci mai yawa a gare ni." Sturridge ya gaya wa LiverpoolFC.com.
rows.reference: Sturridge ya faɗa a LiverpoolFC.com cewa “Kawai wani ƙoƙari ne na shiga wannan wurin, na samun ƙwallon kuma ‘yan wasa kamar Shaq koyaushe wasa suke yi a gaba yadda zai yiwu, don haka na yi kawai ƙoƙari ne na ƙirƙira wa kaina wani lokaci yadda zai yiwu.”

rows.output: "Na ga Kante yana zuwa sai na ɗauki wani lokaci na kuma ban yi tunanin hakan sosai ba kuma kawai na dau mataki na harbi."
rows.reference: “Na ga Kante yana zuwa kuma ya taɓa sau ɗaya kuma ban yi tunani game da shi sosai ba don haka sai na yi bugun kawai.”

rows.output: Chelsea ta jagoranci 1-0 a rabin lokaci bayan ta samu maki a minti na 25 daga Eden Hazard, dan wasan Belgium.
rows.reference: Chelsea ita ce a gaba da ci 1 da 0 a farkon rabin lokaci bayan ta sami wani ci a cikin minti na 25 daga tauraron Belgium Eden Hazard.

rows.output: Dan wasan Blues ya buga kwallon baya ga Mateo Kovacic a wannan wasan, kafin ya juya daga tsakiyar filin wasa ya yi gudu zuwa rabin Liverpool.
rows.reference: Ɗan wasa mai kai hari na Blues ya sake miƙa ƙwallo zuwa ga Mateo Kovacic a wasan, kafin ya ruga zuwa tsakiyar filin da kuma dira a cikin rabin Liverpool ɗin.

rows.output: Kovacic ya yi sauyawa da sauri a tsakiyar filin wasa.
rows.reference: Nan da nan kuna Kovacic ya yi wata miƙawa ya ruga a tsakiyar filin.

rows.output: Sannan ya yi kwallon taushi, yana jagorantar Hazard zuwa cikin akwatin.
rows.reference: Sa’an nan sai ya yi wani kyakkyawan buga ƙwallon, inda ya tura Hazard cikin akwatin.

rows.output: Hazard ya zarce tsaron kuma ya ci gaba da buga kwallo a cikin ragar bayan, yana buga kwallon da kafarsa ta hagu a kan Liverpool's Alisson Becker.
rows.reference: Hazard ya wuce masu tsaron gida kuma ya gama zuwa matsayar raga mai nisa da sauri da wata ƙafar hagun inda ya wuce Alisson Becker na Liverpool.

rows.output: Liverpool na fafatawa da Napoli a matakin rukuni na gasar zakarun Turai a karfe 3 na rana a ranar Alhamis a filin wasa na San Paolo a Naples, Italiya.

rows.output: Chelsea za ta kara da Videoton a gasar cin kofin Europa a ranar Alhamis a London da misalin ƙarfe 3 na rana.

rows.output: An samu mutuwar mutane 832 a Indonesia sakamakon tsunami.

rows.output: An samu mutuwar mutane 832 a cikin girgizar kasa da tsunami da suka afku a Indonesia, a cewar hukumar bala'i ta kasar a safiyar Lahadi.
rows.reference: Ƙididdigar mutuwar a girgizar ƙasar ta Indonesiyan ya haura zuwa 832, inji hukumar kula da bala’i ta ƙasar a farkon ranar Lahadi.

rows.output: An ruwaito cewa mutane da yawa sun makale a cikin tarkacen gine-ginen da suka fado sakamakon girgizar kasa mai karfin 7.5 da ta afku a ranar Juma'a, wadda ta haifar da igiyoyin ruwa har zuwa ƙafa 20, in ji mai magana da yawun hukumar Sutopo Purwo Nugroho a wani taron manema labarai.
rows.reference: Abin ya ritsa da mutane masu yawa a cikin burbushin gine-gine da girgizar ƙasar mai ƙarfi na 7.5 ta rusa wadda ta auku ranar Juma’a da kuma ta jawo tashin jijiyoyin ruwa har tsawon taku 20, inji mai magana da yawun hukumar Sutopo Purwo Nugroho a lokacin da yake bayani a taron manema labarai.

rows.output: Birnin Palu, wanda ke da fiye da mutane 380,000, ya cika da tarkace daga gine-ginen da suka ruguje.
rows.reference: Birnin Palu, mai mutane fiye da 380,000, ka kasance da ɓaraƙuzan rusassun gine-gine birjit.

rows.output: An kama mutumin, mai shekaru 32, bisa zargin kisan gilla bayan an kashe wata mata da wuka.
rows.reference: ‘Yan sanda sun kama mutum, mai shekaru 32, a kan tuhuma bayan kashe mata ta hanyar caka mata wuƙa

rows.output: An fara bincike kan kisan gilla bayan an gano gawar mace a Birkenhead, Merseyside a wannan safiya.
rows.reference: An ƙaddamar da wani bincike bayan an sami gawar wata mata a cikin Birkenhead, Merseyside wannan safiyar.

rows.output: An gano mutumin mai shekaru 44 a lokacin da aka samu a 7.55 na safe a Grayson Mews a kan John Street, inda aka kama wani mutum mai shekaru 32 da ake zargin kisan kai.
rows.reference: An sami mai shekaru 44 ne da karfe 7:55 na safe da raunuka na caka wuka a kan Grayson Mews da ke kan Titin John, tare da kama wani mutum mai shekaru 32 da ake tuhuma da kisan.

rows.output: Jami'an 'yan sanda sun yi kira ga mutanen yankin da suka ga ko ji wani abu, su fito.
rows.reference: ‘Yan sanda sun nemi mutane da ke yankin da suka gani ko kuma suka ji wani abu da su garzayo.

rows.output: Jami'in binciken, Brian O'Hagan ya ce: "Binciken ya fara ne amma zan yi kira ga duk wanda ya kasance a kusa da titin John a Birkenhead wanda ya ga ko ya ji wani abu da ba a sani ba ya tuntuɓe mu.
rows.reference: Sufeto Mai Bincike Brian O'Hagan ya ce: ‘Binciken yana matakan farko-farko ne amma zan yi kira ga duk wanda ke kewayen Layin John a Birkenhead wanda ya gani ko kuma ya ji wani abu da bai yarda da shi ba da ya tuntuɓe mu.

rows.output: Zan kuma roƙi duk wanda ya ga wani abu, musamman direbobin mota, wanda ya yi amfani da kyamarar dashcam, da ya tuntuɓe mu domin za su iya ba mu bayanai masu muhimmanci ga bincike namu.
rows.reference: Har ila yau zan sake kira ga kowa, musamman direbobin tasi, waɗanda ƙila sun ɗauki hoto a kyamarar da ke cikin gaban mota da su tuntuɓe mu don ba mamaki ƙila suna da bayani da ke da muhimmanci ga bincikenmu.'

rows.output: Wani jami'in 'yan sanda ya tabbatar da cewa matar da aka samu gawarwaki a cikin gida tana cikin garin Birkenhead kuma an samu ta a cikin gidan.
rows.reference: Wani mai magana da yawun ‘yan sanda ya tabbatar da cewa matar da aka sami gawar tata ‘yar yankin na Birkenhead ne kuma an same ta ne a cikin wani gini.

rows.output: Yau da safe abokai da suke ganin sun san matar sun iso wurin da aka gano ta a safiyar yau don tambayar inda aka samu ta.
rows.reference: Yau da rana abokai waɗanda suka yi imani sun san matar sun je wurin da abin ya faru don yin tambayoyi game da inda aka same ta wannan safiyar.

rows.output: Ana ci gaba da bincike yayin da 'yan sanda suka ce suna cikin tsarin sanar da 'yan uwa na wanda abin ya shafa.
rows.reference: Ana ci gaba da bincike-bincike kamar yadda ‘yan sanda suke cewa suna cikin shirin gaya wa ‘yan uwan wadda abin ya shafa.

rows.output: Wani direban taksi da ke zaune a Grayson Mews ya yi ƙoƙarin komawa gidan sa, amma ‘yan sanda sun gaya masa cewa babu wanda aka yarda ya shiga ko ya fito daga ginin.
rows.reference: Wani direban tasi da ke zaune a Grayson Mews ya yi ƙoƙarin ya koma cikin gidansa amma ‘yan sanda sun gaya masa cewa ba a yarda wani ya shiga ciki ko fita daga ginin ba.

rows.output: Ya yi shuru lokacin da ya gano abin da ya faru.

rows.output: An gaya wa mazauna yanzu za a bar su su dawo ciki bayan sa'o'i da yawa.
rows.reference: An gaya wa mazaunan cewa zai ɗauki sa’o’i kafin a bari su koma ciki.

rows.output: Wani jami'in 'yan sanda ya ji yana gaya wa wani mutum cewa dukkan yankin yanzu ana daukarsa a matsayin wurin aikata laifi.

rows.output: Wani mutum ya bayyana a wurin a cikin kuka.

rows.output: An yi wa wasu jami'an aiki a cikin katangar da ke kewaye da ginin.

rows.output: An yi wa ginshiƙin majalisar Cromwell sabon abin tunawa da aka yi wa 'sake rubuta tarihin'

rows.output: Zai zama adalci na waƙa ga zaluntar da ya yi wa al'adu da abubuwan addini na Ingila da masu biyayya na Puritan masu tsananin imani.

rows.output: Amma kungiyar Cromwell ta bayyana shawarar Mista Crick a matsayin "hauka" kuma "yunkurin sake rubuta tarihi."
rows.reference: Amma Al’ummar Cromwell sun bayyana shawarar ta Mista Crick a matsayin “wauta” da “ƙoƙari na sake rubuta tarihi.”

rows.output: John Goldsmith, shugaban kungiyar Cromwell Society, ya ce: "Ya kasance abu mai sauki a cikin muhawara ta yanzu game da cire abubuwan tunawa da ke cikin ginin fadar Westminster da hoton Oliver Cromwell zai zama wanda aka yi wa hari.
rows.reference: John Goldsmith, shugaban Al’ummar Cromwell, ya ce: “Ba za a iya gujewa a cikin mahawarar da ake yi yanzu ba game da cire mutum-mutumi cewa surar Oliver Cromwell a wajen Fadar Westminster za ta zama wani abin da ake hari.

rows.output: Yakin basasan Ingila ba a umarce shi ba, kuma ba ya aiwatar da Cromwell.
rows.reference: Yin hari a kan fitattun abubuwa na yaƙe-yaƙen basasar Ingila ba Cromwell na ba da oda a yi ko ya aikata ba.

rows.output: Wataƙila an yi wa Cromwell ba daidai ba don ayyukan kakansa Thomas a ƙarni na baya.

rows.output: Bakin William Hamo Thorneycroft na Cromwell yana nuna ra'ayin karni na 19 da kuma wani bangare na tarihin tarihin wani mutum da da yawa ke ganin ya cancanci murnar.
rows.reference: Akwai babbar bayani game da Cromwell na Sa William Hamo Thorneycroft da ke zama hujjar ra’ayi na karni na 19 wanda kuma ɓangare na ilimin bayanan tarihin na wani sananne wanda mafi yawa suka yi imani har yanzu ya kamata a yi murna a kansa.

rows.output: Mr Goldsmith ya gaya wa The Sunday Telegraph: "Cromwell ana ganin sa da yawa, wataƙila fiye a ƙarshen karni na 19 fiye da yau, a matsayin mai kare majalisar dokoki daga matsin lamba daga waje, a cikin yanayin sa na musamman, sarauta.
rows.reference: Mista Goldsmith ya faɗa a jaridar The Sunday Telegraph: “Mutane da yawa suna ɗaukan Cromwell, watakila sosai a shekarun karshe na karni na 19 fiye da yau, a matsayin mai kare majalisar dokoki daga matsi na waje, a cikin rikicin ba makawa da mulkin sarauta.

rows.output: Ko dai wannan cikakken bayani ne mai kyau, batu ne na ci gaba da muhawara ta tarihi.

rows.output: Abin da ya tabbatar shi ne cewa rikicin tsakiyar karni na 17 ya tsara ci gaban da ya biyo baya na ƙasar mu, kuma Cromwell mutum ne mai iya ganewa wanda ke wakiltar ɗaya daga cikin bangunan da ke cikin wannan rarrabuwar.

rows.output: A halin yanzu, rikicin siyasa ya ci gaba, inda masu watsa labarai suka katse shirye-shiryen yau da kullun don wani juyi na karshe na ranar Juma'a: wani yarjejeniyar da Sanatan Arizona Jeff Flake ya tsara don FBI ta gudanar da bincike na makonni guda kan zarginsa.

rows.output: Amma Flake ya ce zai yi haka ne kawai idan FBI ta duba zarge-zargen da ake yi wa wanda aka zaba na mako mai zuwa, wanda 'yan jam'iyyar Democrat na kananan hukumomi ke roka.

rows.output: Bayan an yi wa Simpson tambayoyi, ‘yan sanda sun ce ya amince da kashe Wayde.
rows.reference: Bayan tambayan Simpson, ‘yan sanda sun ce ya amsa laifi na mummunan harbin Wayde.

rows.output: An sanya hannun jarinsa a kan dala 350,000, a cewar The Advocate.
rows.reference: An sa kuɗin belinsa a dala 350,000, a cewar rahoton Advocate.

rows.output: Ofishin Coroner na East Baton Rouge Parish ya fitar da rahoton farko a ranar Juma'a, yana mai cewa dalilin mutuwar shi ne raunukan bindigar da aka yi a kai da wuyansa.
rows.reference: Ofishin Mai Binciken a kan Musabbabin Kisa na Baton Rouge ta Gabas ya saki wani rahoton farko ranar Jumu’a, yana cewa musabbabin mutuwar wani harbin bindiga ne zuwa ga ka da ya wuce cikin wuya.

rows.output: Sashen ya ba da kiredit ga Louisiana State Police fugitive task force, dakin bincike na 'yan sanda na jihar, jami'an 'yan sanda na Jami'ar Kudu, da 'yan ƙasar da ke kusa da su don taimakawa wajen bincike wanda ya kai ga kama.
rows.reference: Ma’aikatar ta yabi jami’an ‘yan sanda na Jihar Louisiana masu aikin kama wanda ya gudu, da ɗakin ‘yan sanda na gwajin kimiyyar aikata lafi na jihar, da ‘yan sandan Jami’ar Kudanci da mazauna yanki don taimakawa a binciken da ya kai ga kamen.

rows.output: Jami'in wasan motsa jiki na LSU Joe Alleva ya yabawa jami'an tsaro na yankin da "dokar da ta yi aiki da kuma neman adalci."
rows.reference: Daraktan wasan tsalle-tsalle na LSU Joe Alleva ya gode wa ma’aikatan doka na yankin don irin aikinsu na “jajircewa da ganin an yi adalci.”

rows.output: Sims yana da shekaru ashirin.
rows.reference: Shekarun Sims 20 ne.

rows.output: Mai tsaron baya mai tsayin ƙafa 6-6 ya girma a Baton Rouge, inda mahaifinsa, Wayne, ya buga kwallon kwando ma don LSU.
rows.reference: Mai tsawon tattaki 6 da 6 ya girma ne a cikin Baton Rouge, inda mahaifinsa, Wayne, shi ma ya buga wasan ƙwallon kwando ga LSU.

rows.output: Ya yi maki 5.6 da 2.6 a kowane wasan a kakar da ta gabata.
rows.reference: Yana da matsakaicin maki 5.6 da sake dawo da ƙididdigar ci na 2.6 a wani na lokacin da shuɗe.

rows.output: A ranar Asabar, babban kociyan kwallon kwando na LSU, Will Wade, ya ce tawagar ta "ta ruguza" kuma "ta yi mamaki" da mutuwar Wayde.
rows.reference: A ranar Juma’a da safe, mai horar da ‘yan wasan ƙwallon kwandon na LSU Will Wade ya ce ƙungiyar ta sami “tashin hankali” da “girgiza” da mutuwar ta Wayde.

rows.output: "Wannan shine abin da kake damuwa da shi a kowane lokaci," in ji Wade.
rows.reference: “Wannan shi ne abin mutum yake damuwa game da shi a dukkan lokaci,” inji Wade.

rows.output: Wuta ta bazu a birnin Mexico
rows.reference: Babban dutsi mai amon wuta ya fesa toka a kan Birnin Mexico

rows.output: Tsaunukan Popocatepetl sun haifar da hayaƙi, wanda ya kai ga unguwannin kudu na babban birnin Mexico.
rows.reference: Toka da ke fesuwa daga babban dutsi mai amon wuta na Popocatepetl ta isa makwaɓta na kudancin babban birnin Mexico.

rows.output: Cibiyar Kariya ta Kasa ta yi gargadi ga 'yan ƙasar Mexico a ranar Asabar da su kiyaye tafiyarsa daga tsauni bayan da aka samu karuwar aikin a cikin kogon kuma ya yi rajistar fitar da iskar gas da kura 183 a cikin sa'o'i 24.
rows.reference: Cibiyar Hana Haɗura ta Ƙasa ta gargaɗi ‘yan Mexico a ranar Asabar kar su kusanci dutsin bayan abin ya kai koli a farfashewar inda kuma a ka yi rijistar fitar da hayaƙi na iskar gas 183 da kuma toka ta fiye da sa’o’i 24.

rows.output: Cibiyar tana kula da motsin ƙasa da girgizar ƙasa da yawa.
rows.reference: Cibiyar tana kula da cidodi da girgize-girgizen ƙasa.

rows.output: Hotunan da ke kan kafar sada zumunta sun nuna yadda ƙananan guntun ash ke rufe tagogin motocin a ungozoma a birnin Mexico kamar Xochimilco.
rows.reference: Hotuna a hanyar sadarwa ta zumunta sun nuna mashimfiɗu marassa kauri na toka suna danƙare a jikin gilasan mota a cikin makwaɓta na Birnin Mexico kamar su Xochimilco.

rows.output: An lura da karuwar ayyukan a cikin tsauni da ke da nisan mil 45 (72 km) kudu maso gabas da babban birnin kasar tun bayan girgizar kasa mai karfin 7.1 da ta afku a tsakiyar Mexico a watan Satumba na 2017.
rows.reference: Masana kimiyyar yanayi sun lura da wani karin aiki a dutsin da ke zaune a mil 45 (kilomita 72) kudu-maso-gabas na babban birnin tun daga wata girgizar kasa da aka yi mai girman 7.1 da ta raguza tsakiyar Mexico a Satumba 2017.

rows.output: Tsaunin da aka sani da "Don Goyo" ya kasance mai aiki tun daga 1994.
rows.reference: Dutsi mai amon wutar da ake kira "Don Goyo" ya daɗe yana tashi tun 1994.

rows.output: Rundunar ‘yan sanda sun yi artabu da masu fafutukar ‘yancin kai na Catalan a ranar da ta gabata da bikin yin zaben ‘yancin kai.
rows.reference: ’Yan sanda sun yi arangama da masu neman ɓallewa na Catalan kafin zagayowar bikin neman ‘yanci

rows.output: An kama mutane shida a Barcelona a ranar Asabar bayan da masu goyon bayan 'yancin kai suka yi artabu da 'yan sanda, yayin da dubunnan suka shiga zanga-zangar da ke nuna adawa da ita don tunawa da ranar farko da Catalonia ta yi zabe mai cike da cece kuce kan rabu da juna.
rows.reference: An kama mutane shida a Barcelona a ranar Asabar bayan masu zanga-zangar nuna goyon bayan ‘yanci sun yi fito-na-fito tare da ‘yan sandan kwantar da tarzoma, kuma kamar yadda dubun-dubata suka shiga zanga-zanga ta adawa da juna don bikin zagayowar ranar kaɗa kuri’a da ta raba Catalonia a kan ɓallewa.

rows.output: Wani gungu na masu nuna goyon bayan rabuwa da 'yan sanda na musanya sun jefar da su da kwai, sannan kuma suka jefa fenti, wanda ya haifar da duhu mai yunwa a tituna da aka saba cikawa da masu yawon bude ido.
rows.reference: Wani gungu masu goyon bayan ɓallewar da suka rufe idanuwansu da ‘yan sanda suka riƙe sun jefe su da koyaye da kuma watsa musu fentin foda, inda suka ƙirƙiri wasu gajimare mai duhu a cikin titunan da yawanci sukan cika maƙil da ‘yan yawon shaƙatawa.

rows.output: An yi artabu da dama a baya a wannan rana, inda 'yan sanda suka yi amfani da sanduna wajen sarrafa tashin hankali.
rows.reference: Faɗace-faɗace sun ɓarke a ranar daga baya inda ‘yan sanda suka yi amfani da kulaƙensu don hana faɗan.

rows.output: A cikin sa'o'i da dama, ƙungiyoyin masu goyon bayan 'yancin kai suna ihu "Baiwa, ba gafartawa" sun yi faɗa da masu goyon bayan haɗin kai suna ihu "Rayuya da Spain."
rows.reference: Har fiye da tsawon sa’o’i masu yawa gungu-gungun masu goyon bayan ɓallewar suna amshi “Babu mantuwa, babu yafiya” sun yi rikici da masu zanga-zanga ‘yan son haɗewa suna ihu, Allah ya ja kwanan Spain.”

rows.output: Mutan 14 ne suka samu kulawar asibiti saboda raunukan da suka samu a yayin zanga-zangar, a cewar kafafen yada labarai na gida.
rows.reference: An yi magani a mutane goma sha huɗu don ƙananan raunuka da suka ji a zanga-zangogi, kamar yadda kafofin watsa labarai na gida suka ba da rahoto.

rows.output: Tunanin ya ci gaba da kasancewa a yankin da ke son 'yanci shekara guda bayan ranar 1 ga Oktoba, wanda Madrid ta yi la'akari da shi a matsayin haramun, amma 'yan kasar Catalonia sun yi bikin.
rows.reference: Har yanzu da tashin hankali sosai a lardin da ya sa ‘yanci a zuciyarsa shekara ɗaya bayan zaɓen raba gardama na 1 ga Oktoba wanda Madrid ke ɗauka ba ya bisa doka amma ‘yan Catalan masu neman ɓallewa ke ta yin murna da shi.

rows.output: Masu jefa kuri'a sun zabi da yawa don su zama masu zaman kansu, duk da cewa yawan masu jefa kuri'a ya yi ƙanƙanta, inda masu adawa da rabuwa da su suka fi yin watsi da zaben.
rows.reference: Masu jefa kuri’ar sun yi zaɓe sosai inda suka zaɓi ‘yanci kodayake ba a fito sosai ba inda waɗanda ba sa son ɓallewa suka ƙauracewa zaɓen.

rows.output: Bisa ga hukumomin Catalan, kusan mutane 1000 ne suka ji rauni a shekarar da ta gabata bayan da 'yan sanda suka yi yunƙurin hana zaben ci gaba a rumfunan zaɓe a duk yankin a yayin arangama.
rows.reference: A cewar hukumomin Catalan an aƙalla raunata mutane 1000 ne shekarar da ta wuce bayan ‘yan sanda sun yi ƙoƙarin su tsaida kaɗa kuri’ar da ake yi a wuraren jefa kuri’ar a dukkan faɗin lardin a cikin gumurzun tashin hankali.

rows.output: Ƙungiyar masu goyon bayan 'yancin kai sun yi bacci a ranar Juma'a don hana zanga-zanga a goyon bayan 'yan sanda na kasa.
rows.reference: Gungu-gungu na masu nuna goyon bayan ‘yanci sun yi dandazo waje da dare suna goyon baya na ‘yan sandan ƙasa.

rows.output: An yi zanga-zangar amma an tilasta musu su dau wani sabon hanya.
rows.reference: Zanga-zangar ta ci gaba amma an tilasta mata ɗaukan wata hanya daban.

rows.output: Narcis Termes, 68, wani mai aikin lantarki da ke halartan zanga-zangar masu son rabuwa da matarsa ​​sun ce ba su da fatarar samun 'yancin kai na Catalonia.
rows.reference: Narcis Termes, mai shekaru 68, wani latirisha da ke halartar zanga-zangar ‘yan neman ɓallewar tare da matarsa ya ce ba ya kuma fatan ganin yiwuwar Catalonia ta sami ‘yanci.

rows.output: "Shekarar da ta gabata mun rayu ta hanyar daya daga cikin mafi kyawun lokacinmu.
rows.reference: “Shekarar da ta wuce mun rayu a cikin ɗaya daga cikin lokacinmu mafi kyau.

rows.output: Na kalli iyayena suna kuka da farin ciki da za su iya yin zabe amma yanzu mun makale," ya ce.
rows.reference: Na kalli iyayena suna kukan murna saboda damar jefa kuri’a amma yanzu mun tsaya ciki,” inji shi.

rows.output: Duk da cewa sun yi nasara mai muhimmanci, ko da a kan iyaka, a zaben yankin da aka yi a watan Disamba na baya, jam'iyyun pro-independence na Catalan sun yi gwagwarmaya wajen ci gaba da samun kuzari a wannan shekara, yayin da yawancin shugabannin da aka fi sani da su sun yi gurgu a cikin gurgu ko kuma a tsare a jiran shari'a bisa la'akari da rawar da suka taka wajen gudanar da zaben da kuma sanar da 'yancin kai.
rows.reference: Duk da gudanar da wata muhimmiyar nasara ko da tsukekkiya ce a cikin zaɓuɓɓukan yankin a Disamba da ta wuce, jam’iyyun da ke goyon bayan ‘yanci na Catalan sun yi gwagwarmaya don su ci gaba da hazaƙar wannan shekarar tare da yawancin sanannun fitattun shugabanninsu ko dai sun tafi neman mafakar da suka sa kansu ko an kame su suna jiran shari’a don rawarsu da suka taka a cikin shirya zaɓen raba gardamar da furuci na ‘yanci da suka yi daga baya.

rows.output: Joan Puig, mai shekaru 42 mai aikin gyaran mota, wanda ke rubuta zanga-zangar goyon bayan ‘yan sanda a wayarsa, ya ce rikicin ya kara ta’azzara ne ta hanyar ‘yan siyasa a bangunan biyu.
rows.reference: Joan Puig, wani makanike mai shekaru 42 da ke daukan zanga-zanga a cikin goyon baya na ‘yan sanda a kan tarho dinsa, ya ce rikicin ya sami ruruwa ne daga ‘yan siyasa da ke dukkan bangarorin.

rows.output: "Yana ƙara ƙara ƙunci," ya ce.
rows.reference: “Yana ƙara ƙazanta sosai,” inji shi.

rows.output: A ranar Asabar, Oriol Junqueras, daya daga cikin shugabannin Catalonia tara da ke zaman gidan yari tun karshen shekarar da ta gabata, ya sanar da cewa zai tsayar da takarar zama a zaben majalisar dokokin Turai a shekarar mai zuwa.
rows.reference: A ranar Asabar, Oriol Junqueras, ɗaya daga shugabanni tara na Catalan da ke tsare kafin a fara shari’a tun ƙarshen shekarar da ta wuce, ya sanar cewa zai tsaya zaɓuɓɓukan Majalisar Dokoki ta Turai a shekara mai zuwa.

rows.output: "Tsayuwa a matsayin dan takarar zaben Turai hanya ce mafi kyau ta nuna adawa da raguwar dabi'un dimokuradiyya da kuma zalunci da gwamnatin Sipaniya ta yi," ya ce.
rows.reference: “Tsayawa a matsayin wani ɗan takara don zaɓuɓɓukan Turai shi ne hanya mafi kyau ta kin koma baya a kimomin dimokuraɗiyya da zalunci da muka gani daga gwamnatin Spain,” inji shi.

rows.output: Londonderry: An kama mutane bayan motar ta yi katsalandan a gidan
rows.reference: Londonderry: An kama masu maza bayan an doka mota a gida

rows.output: Mutane uku, masu shekaru 33, 34 da 39, an kama su bayan an yi wa motar harbin a wani gida a Londonderry.
rows.reference: An kama wasu maza, masu shekaru 33, 34 da 29, bayan an ta maimaita doka wata ƙaramar mota zuwa cikin wani gida a da ke Londonderry.

rows.output: Lamarin ya faru a Ballynagard Crescent a ranar Alhamis da misalin karfe 19:30 na yamma.
rows.reference: Abin ya faru ne a cikin Ballynagard Crescent a ranar Alhamis da kusan ƙarfe 19:30 BST.

rows.output: Det Insp Bob Blemmings ya ce an yi barna ga ƙofofin da ginin da kansa.
rows.reference: Mataimakin Sufeto Bob Blemmings ya ce an lalata ƙofofi da ma gidan kansa.

rows.output: Wani katon bawul na iya harbin motar a wani lokaci.
rows.reference: An kuma harba ƙila kwari da baka a kan ƙaramar motar a wani lokaci.

rows.output: Menga strike gives Livingston 1-0 win over Rangers
rows.reference: Cin da Menga ya yi ba wa Livingston nasara 1 da 0 a kan Rangers

rows.output: Dolly Menga ta zura kwallo ta farko a raga a wannan kakar a Livingston ta samu nasara
rows.reference: Cin ƙwallon Dolly Menga ya ba wa Livingston samun nasara

rows.output: An yi wa Livingston karaya, wanda ya yi wa Rangers mamaki, ya sanya Steven Gerrard ya yi rashin nasara na biyu a cikin wasanni 18 da ya yi a matsayin manaja na kulob din Ibrox.
rows.reference: Livingston da aka ƙara wa girma ta ba da mamaki ga Rangers inda ta ajiye Steven Gerrard kawai zuwa ga cinsa da aka yi karo na biyu a cikin wasanni 18 a matsayinsa na manaja na kulob ɗin Ibrox.

rows.output: Kwallon da Dolly Menga ta yi ta nuna bambamci, yayin da Gary Holt's ya yi daidai da Hibernian a matsayi na biyu.
rows.reference: Harin da Dolly Menga ya yi ya kasance abin da kawo bambanci saboda ɓangaren Gary Holt ya motsa lebur tare da Hibernian a cikin mataki na biyu.

rows.output: Kungiyar Gerrard ta ci gaba da rashin nasara a wani gida a gasar Premier a wannan kakar kuma za ta fuskanci Hearts, wanda ke kan gaci da maki takwas, a ranar Lahadi mai zuwa.
rows.reference: Ɓangaren Gerrard yana nan ba tare da wata nasara da zai ta fi da ita ba a cikin wasan Premiership ɗin wannan lokacin kuma zai fuskanci Leaders Hearts, waɗanda suke bi da digo takwas, Lahadi mai zuwa.

rows.output: Kafun nan, Rangers na karbar Vienna a gasar Europa a ranar Alhamis.
rows.reference: Kafin nan, Rangers sun karɓi Rapid Vienna a cikin wasan Europa League a ranar Alhamis.

rows.output: Livingston, a halin yanzu, sun tsawaita rashin nasara a gasar zuwa wasanni shida, yayin da kocin su Holt ya ci gaba da rashin nasara tun da ya maye gurbin Kenny Miller a watan da ya gabata.
rows.reference: A lokacin da ake ciki hakan, Livinsgton, sun kara matsayinsu na ba wanda ya doke su a cikin shiyyar zuwa wasanni shida, tare da shugaban horar da wasa Holt har yanzu don ɗanɗana dokewa tun da ya maye gurbin Kenny Miler wata da ya wuce.

rows.output: Livingston sun rasa damarmaki a kan baƴa masu ziyartar gida
rows.reference: Livingston sun rasa damammaki a kan maziyartansu da ba su dama

rows.output: Tawagar Holt ya kamata ta kasance a gaba tun da dadewa kafin su ci, saboda hanyar da suka bi ta haifar da matsaloli da yawa ga Rangers.
rows.reference: Ya kamata a ce ƙungiyar Holt suna gaba ne kafin su ci, tare da fuskantar tasu wanda ke haifar wa Rangers matsaloli iri-iri.

rows.output: Scott Robinson ya yi nasarar shiga cikin ragon, amma ya ja kwallonsa a saman kwallon, sannan Alan Lithgow ya yi kokarin buga kwallo a gefe bayan ya yi tsalle ya hadu da kwallon Craig Halkett a gefen kwallon.
rows.reference: Scott Robinson ya shige ciki amma ya ja ƙoƙarinsa ta gaban fuska ta cin nasara, shi ke nan Alan Lithgow kawai zai iya fuskantar da ƙoƙarinsa bayan yin ƙasa don haɗuwa da bugu da ka na cin Craig Halkett.

rows.output: Masu masaukin baki sun yi farin ciki su bar Rangers su yi wasa a gaban su, suna sane da cewa za su iya damun baƴan baƙi a lokacin da za a yi wasan.
rows.reference: Masu saukan bakin sun yarda su bar Rangers su buga wasa a gabansu, suna sane da cewa za su iya wahalar da masu ziyarar a jerin ɗaiɗaiku.

rows.output: Kuma haka ne aka samu muhimmiyar kwallo.
rows.reference: Kuma wancan shi ne yadda ci mai muhimmancin ya gudana.

rows.output: Rangers sun yi wa 'yan wasa 'yancin kai, kuma Livingston sun yi amfani da wani wuri, Declan Gallagher da Robinson sun haɗa don saita Menga, wanda ya ɗauki wani lokaci ya ci daga tsakiyar akwatin.
rows.reference: Rangers sun amince da bugun da ba tarewa kuma Livingston suka yi aiki da wata dama, Declan Gallagher da Robinson suka haɗe suka tsara Menga, wanda ya taɓa da kuma ci daga tsakiya ta akwatin.

rows.output: A wannan mataki, Rangers sun mamaye mallakar kwallon amma sun sami tsaron gida mai karfi kuma mai tsaron gida Liam Kelly ba a damu da shi sosai.
rows.reference: A wannan mataki, Rangers ta mamaye riƙe ƙwallo amma ta sami tsaron gidan ba zai ba da damar wucewa ba kuma mai kama ƙwallo Liam Kelly kuma gaba ɗaya bai damu ba.

rows.output: Wannan tsarin ya ci gaba zuwa rabin na biyu, duk da haka Alfredo Morelos ya tilasta wa Kelly ya yi tsalle.
rows.reference: Wannan yanayi ya ci gaba har rabi na biyu, kodayake Alfredo Morelos ya tilasta wani ceto daga Kelly.

rows.output: An hana Scott Pittman daga ƙafa ta mai tsaron gida na Rangers Allan McGregor, kuma an yi wa Lithgow kaca-kaca daga wani tsarin wasan Livingston.
rows.reference: Scott Pittman bai samu dama ba daga ƙafa ta mai kama ƙwallo na Rangers Allan McGregor kuma Lithgow ya buɗa sosai daga wani wasan da Livingston ya tsara.

rows.output: Kwallayen suna shiga akwatin Livingston akai-akai kuma ana ci gaba da share su, yayin da aka yi ikirari biyu na bugu - bayan kalubalen Halkett kan dan wasa Glenn Middleton, da kuma daya don bugu - an yi watsi da su.
rows.reference: Sai kuma bugu ta ko’ina da suka riƙa zuwa cikin akwatin Livingston inda kuma a ci gaba da maganinsu, a yayin da aka samu bugu daga kai sai gola - bayan ƙalubalantar Halkett a kan maye gurbin Glenn Middleton, kuma ɗaya don taɓawa da hannu - inda aka ture gefe.

rows.output: 'Phenomenal' daga Livingston - nazari

rows.output: Wani aiki mai ban mamaki da kuma sakamakon da ya faru ga Livingston.
rows.reference: Wani wasa mai ban mamaki da sakamako don Livingston.

rows.output: Ga mutum, sun kasance masu kyau, suna ci gaba da wuce tsammanin a kan wannan hanyar hawa.
rows.reference: Ga wani mutum, sun burge sosai, suna ci gaba da wuce abin da ake tsammani a kan wannan abin da ya yi saman.

rows.output: Salon wasan su da kuma 'yan wasa ba su canza sosai tun da suka dawo gasar farko ba, amma babban yabuwa ya kamata ya tafi ga Holt saboda yadda ya kara wa kungiyar kuzari tun da ya iso.
rows.reference: Irin salonsu na wasa da ma’aikata ya dan canza tun da dawowarsu zuwa saman matsayi, amma babban yabo ya kamata ya je ne ga Holt da irin hanyar da ya haɗa ƙungiyar tun zuwansa.

rows.output: Ya yi da yawa daga cikin jaruman.
rows.reference: Yana da gwarzaye da yawa.

rows.output: Kyaftin Halkett ya kasance mai girma, yana gudanar da tsaron da ya yi kyau, yayin da Menga ya ci gaba da Connor Goldson da Joe Worrall a duk lokacin.
rows.reference: Kyaftin Halkett ya shirya, inda ya yi ta tsara wani tsaro mai kyau, a lokacin da Menga ya sa Connor Goldson da Joe Worrall suka kasance a kan ƙafafunsu gaba ɗaya.

rows.output: Rangers ba su da kuzari, duk da haka.
rows.reference: Rangers sun kusan rasa ƙarfin gwiwa, kusan.

rows.output: Kamar yadda suka kasance masu kyau a wasu lokuta a karkashin jagorancin Gerrard, sun yi kasa da ma'aunin da suka kafa.
rows.reference: Duk da irin yadda suke da kyau a lokutan a ƙarƙashin Gerrard, sun gaza samun irin wadannan daidaituwar.

rows.output: Kwallonsa na karshe ya yi rashin - kawai sau daya suka yanke gefen gida - kuma hakan wani gargaɗi ne ga Rangers, wanda ya sami kansa a tsakiyar teburin.
rows.reference: Ƙwallonsu ta ƙarshe ba ta isa ba - kawai sau ɗaya ne suka yanke gefen gidan a buɗe - kuma wani abu ne na wartsakarwar kira ga Rangers, waɗanda suka sami kansu a cikin tsakiyar teburi.

rows.output: An yi ta jira da mutane da yawa a wani biki a bakin teku a birnin Palu a ranar Juma'a lokacin da igiyoyin ruwa masu tsayi kimanin mita shida (kafa 18) suka yi kaca-kaca a bakin teku a lokacin fadowa, inda suka kwashe mutane da yawa da rayukansu kuma suka lalata duk wani abu da ke kan hanyarsu.
rows.reference: Ɗaruruwan mutane suka taru don wani biki a kan teku na birnin Palu a ranar Juma’a a yayin da igiyoyin ruwan da suka mitoci shiɗa a sama (taku 18) suka afka bakin teku da dare, inda suka share da yawa suka mutu da lalata kowane abu da ke hanyar tasu.

rows.output: An bi da tsunami bayan girgizar ƙasa mai ƙarfi 7.5.
rows.reference: Tsunamin ta biyo bayan wata girgizar ƙasa mai ƙarfin 7 da ɗigo 5.

rows.output: "Lokacin da aka samu barazana ta tsunami jiya, mutane har yanzu suna yin ayyukan su a bakin teku kuma ba su yi gudu nan take ba, kuma sun zama wanda ya ji rauni," in ji Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, mai magana da yawun hukumar kasa ta Indonesia ta BNPB a wani taro a Jakarta.
rows.reference: “A yayin da barazanar tsunamin ta taso jiya, mutane a lokacin suna ayyukansu ne a kan bakin tekun kuma ba su gudu nan da nan ba inda suka zama waɗanda abin ya shafa,” inji Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, mai magana da yawun hukumar rage haɗura ta Indonesiya ta BNPB a cikin wata gajeruwar ganawa da ‘yan jarida a cikin Jakarta.

rows.output: "Harin tsunami bai zo da kansa ba, ya ja motoci, itatuwan, gidajen, ya bugi komai a kasa," in ji Nugroho, inda ya kara cewa tsunami ya yi tafiya a cikin teku mai fadi da saurin kilometa 800 a sa'a (497 mph) kafin ya bugi gabar teku.
rows.reference: “Tsunamin tazo da kanta ne, ta jawo ƙananan motoci, katakwaye, gidaje, ta kuma bugi duk abin da ke kan ƙasa,” inji Nugroho, inda ya kara da cewa tsunami ta yi tafiya a faɗin buɗeɗɗen teku da gudu na kilomita 800 kowace sa’a (mil 497 kowace sa’a) kafin ta sauka a bakin tekun.

rows.output: Wasu mutane sun haura bishiyar domin su gujewa tsunami kuma suka rayu, ya ce.
rows.reference: Wasu mutanen sun hau bishiyoyi ne don tsira daga tsunami kuma sun rayu, inji shi.

rows.output: Kimanin mutane 16,700 an kwashe su zuwa cibiyoyin 24 a Palu.
rows.reference: An kwashe kusan mutane 16,700 zuwa cibiyoyi 24 da ke cikin Palu.

rows.output: Hotunan da aka fitar daga hukumar bala'i sun nuna cewa an lalata gidaje da shaguna da dama, an murɗe gadoji, an ruguje kuma wani masallaci ya mamaye da ruwa.
rows.reference: Hotunan da aka ɗauka daga sama da hukumar haɗarin ta sake sun nuna gine-gine da shaguna a lalace, gadojin sun lankwashe da rushewa da wani masallaci ruwa ya kewaye shi.

rows.output: Guguwar girgizar ƙasa ta ci gaba da faru a birnin gabar teku a ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: An ci gaba da samun girgize-girgize na baya da suka addabi birnin da ke kusa da tekun a ranar Asabar.

rows.output: An yi jerin girgizar kasa a yankin da ke da mutane miliyan 2.4.
rows.reference: An ji girgize-girgizen ƙasa a jere a wani yanki mai mutane miliyan 2 da dubu ɗari 4.

rows.output: Hukumar Indonesia mai kula da tantancewa da amfani da fasahar (BPPT) ta ce a wata sanarwa cewa, karfin makamin da aka yi a ranar Juma'a ya kai kusan sau 200 na karfin bam din atomic da aka jefa a Hiroshima a lokacin yakin duniya na biyu.
rows.reference: Hukumar Auna da Aiwatar da Fasaha ta Indonesiya (BPPT) a cikin wata sanarwa ta ce ƙarfi da babbar girgizar ƙasa ta sake a ranar Jumu’ar ya kai kusan sau 200 na ƙarfin bam na sinadarin atom da aka jefa a kan Hiroshima a cikin Yakin Duniya na Biyu.

rows.output: Yankunan da ke kusa da birnin, wanda yake a ƙarshen wani kunkuntar kogin, na iya kara girman tsunami, in ji.
rows.reference: Yanayi na birnin, wanda ke zaune a ƙarshe na wani ɗan ƙaramin ziri mai tsawo, ƙila shi ya faɗaɗa girma na tsunami ɗin, inji ta.

rows.output: Nugroho ya bayyana lalacewar a matsayin "mai girma" kuma ya ce dubunnan gidaje, asibitoci, kasuwanni, da otal-otal sun ruguje.
rows.reference: Nugroho ya bayyana lalacewar a matsayin “mai yawa” kuma ya ce dubun-dubata na gidaje, asibitoci, shagunan cinikayya da otel-otel duk sun ruguje.

rows.output: An gano gawarwakin wasu wanda aka kashe a ƙarƙashin tarkacen ginin da ya ruguje, ya ce, ya kuma kara da cewa mutane 540 sun ji rauni kuma 29 suna bace.
rows.reference: An sami gawarwakin waɗanda abin ya shafa a maƙale a ƙarƙashin gine-gine da suka rushe, inji shi, ya kuma ƙara da cewa mutane 540 sun ji rauni kuma an rasa 29.

rows.output: Nugroho ya ce, an samu asarar rayuka da kuma lalacewar gine-gine na iya karuwa a gabar tekun, kimanin 300 km (190 mil) arewa da Palu, wani yanki da ake kira Donggala, wanda ya fi kusa da tsakiyar girgizar.
rows.reference: Nugroho ya ce yawan masu mutuwar da lalacewar zai ƙaru sosai a layin bakin teku kilomita 300 (mil 190) arewa da Palu, wani yanki da ake kira Donggala,

rows.output: An katse sadarwa "gaba daya" da babu wani bayani daga Donggala, in ji Nugroho.
rows.reference: Sadarwa “gaba ɗaya sun tsaya cik kuma babu labari” daga Donggala, jinji Nugroho.

rows.output: Akwai fiye da mutane 300,000 da ke zaune a wurin, a cewar wata sanarwa da Red Cross ta fitar, inda ta kara da cewa ma'aikatan su da masu aikin sa kai suna kan hanyar zuwa wuraren da abin ya shafa.
rows.reference: Akwai fiye da mutane 300,000 da ke zauna a can,” inji ƙungiyar agaji ta Red Cross a cikin wata sanarwa, tana mai ƙarin cewa ma’aikatanta da masu sa-kai sun nufi yankunan da abin ya shafa.

rows.output: "Wannnan ya riga ya zama bala'i, amma zai iya ƙara tsananta."
rows.reference: “Wannan tuni wani bala’i ne, amma zai iya ƙara muni,” inji ta.

rows.output: Hukumar ta fuskanci suka a ranar Asabar don rashin sanar da cewa wani tsunami ya afku a Palu, duk da cewa jami'an sun ce igiyoyin sun zo cikin lokaci da aka fitar da gargadin.
rows.reference: An soki hukumar a ranar Asabar sosai don rashin sanarwa cewa wata tsunami za ta afka wa Palu, kodayake jami’ai sun ce igiyoyin ruwa sun zo a tsakanin lokacin da aka fitar da gargaɗin.

rows.output: A cikin wani faifan bidiyo na masu sha'awar da aka raba a shafukan sada zumunta, wani mutum a kan bene na sama na wani gini ana jin yana ihu da gargaɗi mai ban tsoro na cikar tsunami ga mutane a kan titi a kasa.
rows.reference: Wani bidiyon da ba ƙwararre ba da aka raba ta kafar sada zumunta za a iya jin wani mutum a kan saman daɓe na wani gini yana ihun girgiza gargaɗi na kusantowar tsunami ga mutane da ke titin ƙasan.

rows.output: A cikin mintuna, katanga na ruwa ya yi kaca a bakin teku, yana dauke da gine-gine da motoci.
rows.reference: A cikin mintina wani bango na ruwa ya faɗo a kan tekun, yana ɗaukewa gine-gine da ƙananan motoci.

rows.output: An ba da damar yin rajista ga Reuters don tabbatar da fushin.
rows.reference: Kamfanin dillacin labarai na Reuters ba iya tantance bidiyon ba nan da nan.

rows.output: Girgizar ƙasa da tsunami sun haifar da katsewar wutar lantarki mai girma wanda ya katse sadarwa a kusa da Palu, wanda ya sa ya yi wuya ga hukumomin da za su tsara ayyukan ceto.
rows.reference: Girgizar ƙasar da tsunamin sun haifar da katsewar lantarki da yanke sadarwa a kewayen Palu inda ya haifar da wahala ga hukumomi wajen haɗin gamayyar ƙoƙare-ƙoƙare na ceto.

rows.output: An fara aika jiragen sama masu kaya da agajin gaggawa daga Jakarta da sauran birane, a cewar jami'an, amma 'yan gudun hijira har yanzu suna buƙatar abinci da sauran abubuwan buƙata.
rows.reference: Sojoji sun fara aika manyan jiragen ɗaukan kaya da tallafi daga Jakarta da sauran birane, inji hukumomi, amma waɗanda aka kwashen har yanzu suna sosai buƙatar abinci da sauran muhimman kayayyaki.

rows.output: An bude filin jirgin na birnin ne kawai don aikin agajin gaggawa kuma zai ci gaba da kasancewa a rufe har zuwa Oktoba.

rows.output: Har ma da masu taimakawa sun fara motsawa da ban tsoro na fara aikin agajin gaggawa, wasu sun yi korafi cewa ma'aikata agajin gaggawa na kasashen waje da suka yi zurfi a fannin ilimi suna hana su tafiya zuwa Palu.
rows.reference: Duk da gungu-gungun ‘yan agaji da suka fara wata babbar hoɓɓasa ta fara aikin tallafi na bala’i, wasu sun yi ƙorafi cewa ma’aikatan agaji na waje da ke ƙwarewa sosai ana hana su tafiya zuwa Palu.

rows.output: Bisa ga dokokin Indonesia, samar da kudi, kayan aiki da ma'aikata daga kasashen waje za su iya farawa ne kawai idan an bayyana wurin bala'i a matsayin yankin bala'i na kasa.

rows.output: "Da zarar gwamnatin ta ce, "O.K., wannan wata matsala ce ta kasa," za mu iya bude don taimakon kasa da kasa amma har yanzu ba a samu matsayi ba."

rows.output: A lokacin da dare na biyu ya zo Palu bayan girgizar kasa da tsunami a ranar Juma'a, abokai da 'yan uwa na wadanda har yanzu ba a gano su ba suna fatan cewa 'yan uwansu za su kasance abubuwan al'ajabi da za su sa labarun da ke tattare da bala'o'i na halitta su yi kyau.
rows.reference: Kamar yadda dare na biyu ya faɗa kan Palu bayan girgizar ƙasa da tsunami ta ranar Jumu’a, abokai da iyali na waɗanda suka ɓata suna ta fatan cewa ‘yan uwan nasu za su zama mu’ujizozi da za su rayar da layukan labari marar daɗi na bala’o’i na ƙasa.

rows.output: Gendon Subandono, kocin tawagar paragliding ta kasa ta Indonesia, ya horar da 'yan paragliding biyu da suka bace don gasar Asiya, wanda ya kare a watan da ya gabata a Indonesia.
